newsitem.title: USA: LOOP tanker loadings expected to resume Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: LOOP tanker loadings expected to resume Tuesday.

text.p: Crude oil tankers are expected to resume loading at the Louisiana Offshore Oil Port (LOOP) later Tuesday, depending on weather conditions.
"(Loadings) are expected to resume today, as soon as the weather allows for it," a LOOP official told Reuters.
Four or five tankers were reported lining up outside the storm waiting to make deliveries.
Pipeline operations and deliveries were not affected by the delay in shipping.
The LOOP is the only deep-water port in U.S. waters and has been shut since Saturday by heavy seas from Tropical Storm Josephine sweeping through the Gulf of Mexico.
The port is about 20 miles south of Grand Isle, Louisiana.
